_comment: A connector is DATA, never code. It says how to read a file, never WHERE that file is - the human picks it. Paths use dots for object keys and [] to walk an array. Nothing here is evaluated.
_verified: MEASURED on 2026-11-19 on a real French Google Takeout of this machine: 10 files under Takeout/Gemini dans Workspace/Conversation History/conversation_*.txt, each ONE conversation in JSON despite the .txt name. 24 user turns, 24 system turns, 32 model thoughts, 7 citations. The key names below come from that file; the words never left it.
_where: Google Takeout, product Gemini (Workspace accounts). The zip holds one conversation_<id>.txt per conversation; the zip reader joins them into one list.
_whyKeyed: A turn is not a record with a role field: it is an object with ONE key, user_turn or system_turn, and that key IS the role. A turn with neither key is counted as unknown-role, never guessed.
_thoughtsWhy: system_turn.model_thoughts is the model's reasoning, shown apart from its answer. It was never said to the person, so it is not kept as Gemini's words; each thought is counted as `thoughts`. Citations are not words either and are left out.
